facts.value: . Our global corporate headquarters, research and development facilities, and manufacturing and distribution centers are located in Pleasanton, California, where we own approximately 148,000 square feet of space and lease approximately 300,000 square feet of space under leases expiring between September 2029 and June 2033, as well as a manufacturing and distribution center in Singapore and a manufacturing center in Taiwan. Including the Pleasanton leases, we lease approximately 431,000 square feet globally. We believe that our current and planned facilities are sufficient to meet our ongoing needs and that, if we require additional space, we will be able to obtain additional facilities on commercially reasonable terms.

facts.value: Facilities Our corporate headquarters are in Madison, Wisconsin. We lease approximately 405,000 square feet world-wide. We lease approximately 247,000 square feet in Madison, Wisconsin for product development, manufacturing, administrative, training and warehouse space. We lease approximately 59,000 square feet in Sunnyvale and Santa Clara, California for product research and development and administrative functions. As of July 1, 2026, we subleased 9,000 square feet of our Santa Clara office space to a third party. We lease approximately 20,000 square feet in Morges, Switzerland, for administrative functions, and lease approximately 5,400 square feet in Genolier, Switzerland for training. We lease approximately 42,000 square feet of space in a manufacturing facility in Chengdu, China. We also lease international offices in China; Hong Kong; Japan; Korea; India; and Spain. We believe our current facilities are adequate to meet our current needs, but additional space, including additional radiation shielded areas in which systems can be assembled and tested, may be required in the future to accommodate anticipated increases in manufacturing needs.

facts.value: Correct the retained Santa Clara not_active flag to current. Accuray's official live locations page lists Accuray Incorporated at Mission Tower II, 3979 Freedom Circle, Suite 700. Item 2 of the fiscal 2026 Form 10-K confirms leased premises in both Santa Clara and Sunnyvale and states that 9,000 square feet of Santa Clara office space was subleased to a third party as of July 1, 2026. This is a partial-space sublease disclosure, not evidence of company or site closure. The filing and current company locations page place corporate headquarters in Madison, Wisconsin; that headquarters/SEC business-address change does not negate California operations. Accuray is the brand and Accuray Incorporated is the named legal operator and SEC reporting company. No controlling corporate parent is identified in the reviewed primary sources; parent is null rather than an invented ownership assertion. The current address supports presence, not the area of Suite 700, remaining company-occupied area, local employment, or market demand. This file is a research correction recommendation only; it does not modify the application database, census, retained evidence, or figures ledger.

facts.label: Bounded physical-presence review
facts.value: Add a separately identified planned-site lead for Bachem in Fricktal, not a current operating-site record. The company places Sisslerfeld in Eiken, not Münchwilen or Basel city. Bachem's 21 July 2026 announcement describes a greenfield project with commercial production expected in 2030. Its 30 July 2026 release again calls Sisslerfeld a planned large-volume manufacturing site; the commissioned Building K discussed in that release is a different project and must not be treated as Sisslerfeld commissioning. The FY2025 annual report identifies Bachem Sisslerfeld AG, with its registered seat in Baden, as a Bachem Holding AG group subsidiary and describes land acquisitions and infrastructure building applications. Eiken's 3 September 2026 notice independently identifies Bachem Sisslerfeld AG as applicant and landowner for the Downstream Center construction-site installations at Südspange Sisslerfeld. That application's publication is not proof that construction was completed, that production buildings were occupied, or that commercial production had begun. The Baden correspondence address is not the Eiken physical site. The official Swiss address search for the project locality returned no results, so no municipal centroid, adjacent-plant location, or invented building pin is supplied. This project is not attributed to adjacent Roche, Novartis, or Lonza plants. The retained basel:site:bachem-bubendorf record remains unchanged. The correction documents a company-specific planned physical project, not current occupied area, active market demand, or a full Fricktal census.

facts.label: Property disclosures / primary filing excerpt
facts.value: CEL-SCI leases approximately 3,700 square feet of office space at 8229 Boone Blvd., Suite 802, Vienna, Virginia at a monthly rental of approximately $8,000. In October 2025, the lease on the office space was extended and expires on May 31, 2031. CEL-SCI believes this arrangement is adequate for the conduct of its present business. CEL-SCI has a 17,900 square foot laboratory located in Baltimore, Maryland. The laboratory is leased by CEL-SCI at a cost of approximately $22,000 per month. The laboratory lease expires on February 29, 2032. In August 2007, CEL-SCI leased a building near Baltimore, Maryland (the San Tomas lease). The building, which consists of approximately 73,000 square feet, has been remodeled in accordance with CEL-SCI’s specifications so that it can be used by CEL-SCI to manufacture Multikine for CEL-SCI’s Phase III clinical trial and sales of the drug, if approved by the FDA. The lease expires on October 31, 2028 and required annual base rent payments of approximately $2.7 million during the twelve months ended September 30, 2025. The annual base rent escalates each year at 3% beginning on November 1st. CEL-SCI is also required to pay all real estate and personal property taxes, insurance premiums, maintenance expenses, repair costs and utilities, which were approximately $86,000 per month as of September 30, 2025. The lease allows CEL-SCI, at its election, to extend the lease for two ten-year periods or to purchase the building at the end of the 20-year lease. In August 2020, the Company entered into an amendment to the San Tomas lease agreement under which the landlord agreed to allow the Company to substantially upgrade the manufacturing facility in preparation for the potential commercial production of Multikine. The total cost of the upgrades was $11.1 million. The landlord agreed to finance the final $2.4 million of the costs incurred. The Company started repaying these costs on March 1, 2021 through increased lease payments which will continue over the remaining lease term. The repayment includes a base rent which escalates at 3% each year plus interest that accrues at 13.75% per year on the $2.4 million financed.

facts.label: Bounded physical-presence review
facts.value: Add the missing verified operating Stein site as a separately labeled Fricktal/Aargau extension outside Basel-Stadt and Basel-Landschaft, under the existing Lonza company profile gco_59823ff9aac271b5cc32. The retained evidence has Lonza Basel headquarters and Stücki records but no Stein site record; those existing records remain unchanged. Lonza's current location page supplies the street address and clinical/commercial manufacturing functions and explicitly states that the site was acquired from Novartis in 2019 [lonza_stein_location]. That acquisition changed the operator; it did not close the site. Lonza announced operational readiness and Swissmedic GMP approval for an additional existing-site aseptic biologics filling line on 2025-10-08 [lonza_stein_swissmedic_20251008]. The dated 2026-07-22 company announcement separately describes a dedicated commercial-scale aseptic ADC project and a large-scale multipurpose drug-product facility as under construction, and announces another ADC line expected to operate in 2030; the large-scale drug-product facility is now expected to start operations in 2028 [lonza_h1_2026_stein_update]. Do not conflate that operating 2025-approved line with the separate uncommissioned commercial-scale expansions. Record Lonza's own operating presence, not the whole adjacent pharmaceutical campus: neither a former Novartis association nor nearby Novartis or Roche plants establishes common current operation or transferable occupancy. Lonza AG is the entity named at this address by the official cantonal apprenticeship portal [lonza_stein_cantonal_operator]; the parent is separately identified as Lonza Group Ltd in the company's legal notice [lonza_group_legal_notice_2025]. These findings establish a physical manufacturing site and distinguish planned capacity. They are not evidence of external real-estate market demand, available space, leasing requirements, or an occupied suite area.

Omnicell's official locations page, retrieved on 2026-11-04, explicitly lists its Milpitas Office at 725 Sycamore Drive (omnicell-locations-live). Item 2, Properties, of the FY2025 Form 10-K separately identifies Milpitas as a material leased facility used for administration, manufacturing, and research and development (omnicell-fy2025-10k). This is affirmative premises evidence, not an inference from the registrant's mailing address. Omnicell, Inc. remains the legal reporting entity in the June 2026 Form 10-Q and the October 2026 corporate release; no different corporate parent is established by these sources, so parent is null rather than an inferred acquirer (omnicell-q2-2026-10q; omnicell-q3-2026-release). The principal executive office is in Fort Worth, Texas, but that does not mean the Milpitas operating facility is closed. The June 2026 Form 10-Q does not identify a Milpitas closure or sublease, and the October 29, 2026 release does not provide a Milpitas-specific premises update. Neither generic restructuring charges nor the Texas executive-office address supports the retained inactive flag. The live street address does not itself establish current occupied suite area or local headcount. The reported historical leased area below is not a new leasing event, available sublease area, incremental absorption, or evidence of current market demand. This correction concerns physical presence and function only; no application database, census, or figures ledger was edited.

facts.value: Retain the existing Basel case with a caveat, rather than exclude Orbis or label a site closed. The live Switzerland Innovation Park Basel Area resident page names Orbis as a Main Campus resident [orbis_sip_resident]. However, its Hegenheimermattweg 167A contact block belongs to the park operator and is not an Orbis company suite address. Orbis's dated 2026-10-27 company statement locates the company in Copenhagen, Denmark and Lausanne, Switzerland, while its footer separately identifies Orbis Medicines ApS in Denmark and Orbis Medicines SA at Superlab Suisse [orbis_company_update_20261027]. Biopôle's live company record identifies Orbis Medicines SA's Swiss R&D activities at Building Serine, Route de la Corniche 6, 1066 Epalinges, outside the Basel analytical region [orbis_biopole]. This supports actual Swiss R&D presence but does not demonstrate that the Basel resident listing is false, former, or closed. The Danish legal entity and Swiss entity must not be collapsed into a Basel headquarters claim. Orbis's September 2026 announcement describes a Novo Nordisk collaboration and strategic investment, not an acquisition or operator replacement [orbis_partnership_20260917]; a controlling parent has not been established. Keep Basel occupancy unresolved, with no company pin, occupied area, local headcount, or lease assumptions. The official SwissSearchServer query matched the verified Epalinges address at address-point precision [orbis_epalinges_geocode]; that out-of-region point is deliberately not substituted for a Basel site. This is a site-evidence correction, not evidence of market demand, expansion, contraction, or closure.

facts.label: Property disclosures / primary filing excerpt
facts.value: We are party to a multi-year, non-cancelable lease agreement for our office space in Waltham, Massachusetts (as subsequently amended in July 2021, April 2022, July 2022, April 2024, September 2024 and September 2025, the “Massachusetts Lease”). In April 2024, we entered into a fourth amendment to the Massachusetts Lease (the “Fourth Amendment”). The Fourth Amendment makes certain modifications to the Massachusetts Lease, including (i) securing 10,427 sq. ft. of office space in the same building (the “New Premises”), (ii) the termination of the 10,956 sq. ft. of leased space under the Massachusetts Lease (the “Original Premises”), and (iii) the extension of the expiration date of the New Premises to July 2029. Under the Fourth Amendment, we have the option to extend the lease term for an additional period of three years upon notice to the landlord. In September 2024, we entered into a fifth amendment to the Massachusetts Lease (the “Fifth Amendment”). The Fifth Amendment makes certain modifications to both the Massachusetts Lease and the Fourth Amendment, including the addition of 2,788 sq. ft. of office space in the same building (the “September 2024 Expansion Premises”). In September 2025, we entered into the sixth amendment to the Massachusetts Lease (the “Sixth Amendment”). The Sixth amendment makes certain modifications to the Massachusetts Lease, including the addition of 5,240 sq. ft. of office space in the same building (the “September 2025 Expansion Premises”). Additionally, we leased approximately 27,128 sq. ft. of office and laboratory space in Boulder, Colorado under a lease that expired in December 2024. In September 2024, we entered into a new, multi-year lease agreement for 7,117 sq. ft. of office and laboratory space in Boulder, Colorado that expires in December 2026. We have the option to extend the lease term for an additional period of five years upon notice to the Landlord.
